pageDescription: A lost palace, peculiar bosses, and you. Discover StarMess, an independent pixel art game in development.
heroTag: An indie pixel art game · in development
heroTitle: Not every palace is built on earth.
heroText: Get lost between the stars. Uncover the secrets of a silent palace and face whatever waits on the other side of the mirror.
aboutText: White stone. Dark corridors. Outside the window: the cosmos. In StarMess, every room hides something that doesn't quite belong.
aboutBody: Explore connected galleries, a library, and a chapel. Find unusual entrances to arenas, learn your opponents' rhythms, and bring light back to places you couldn't reach before.
feature1Text: An interconnected palace full of branching paths, dark corners, and objects that lead to entirely different worlds.
feature2Text: Eight bosses, distinct attack rhythms, and two phases per fight. Watch, dodge, and find your opening.
feature3Text: Unlock local co-op in boss arenas. Two difficulty levels and full controller support let you find your own pace.
